caption: The top of a small pile of dry sand in a sandbox is kicked, and sand sprays forward and leaves a gouge in the pile.

sa.check: A small pile of dry sand is in a sandbox.
The top of it is kicked.
A gouge is left in the pile.
The kick comes first, then the spray and the gouge.

pc.expect: The spray goes in the direction of the kick.
pc.fail: It sprays back at the kicker; or straight up; or the pile moves as one block.

pc.expect: Dry sand flies as grains and falls back a short way off, and the gouge has loose sloping sides.
pc.fail: It clumps like wet sand; or flows like water; or the pile stays intact.

pc.expect: Sprayed sand falls to the ground.
pc.fail: It hangs; or rises; or floats.

pc.expect: The gouge is where the foot struck.
pc.fail: The gouge is elsewhere; or there is no gouge; or the gouge is there before the kick.

pc.expect: The foot keeps its shape and does not pass through the sandbox.
pc.fail: The foot passes through the sandbox floor; or a second foot appears; or the pile turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sandbox and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The sandbox changes; or the sand changes colour; or the surroundings rearrange.

note: The foot is kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
